title: Another set of smuggled cigarettes found on boat in Pangasinan

blocks.text: LINGAYEN, Pangasinan – Police and other law enforcers seized an estimated P15.9 million worth of cigarette contraband from an abandoned mother boat found along a river in Lingayen, Pangasinan, on Monday afternoon. The Agno Municipal Police Station received a report about the abandoned blue-and-green vessel at 4:30 p.m. along the river in Barangay Aloleng. A police report said the boat had no name or identifying markings.
